yt.title: South Korea just passed Britain and France (IMF, 2026) #Shorts
yt.description:
GDP per person, PPP: 1990 Korea $7.7k vs UK $18.3k. 2026: Korea $70.3k, France $68.9k, UK $68.5k (IMF WEO Oct 2026).
